description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultMessageMapperFactory class in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing the loading and creation of message mappers, registry functionalities, and class loading mechanisms.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of DefaultMessageMapperFactory in various scenarios, including mapper loading, creation, and registry management.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures including configuration object and actor system before all tests run.

methods.name: shutDownActorSystem
methods.description: Cleans up and shuts down the actor system after all tests have completed.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, instantiating the factory under test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Tears down the test environment after each test.

methods.name: loadMapperFromFactoryMethod
methods.description: Tests that a mapper can be loaded from a factory method.

methods.name: loadMapperFromClass
methods.description: Tests loading a mapper based on class name.

methods.name: loadMapperWitInvalidOptions
methods.description: Tests behavior when loading a mapper with invalid options.

methods.name: loadMissingMapper
methods.description: Checks behavior when attempting to load a non-existent mapper.

methods.name: loadNonMessageMapperClass
methods.description: Verifies that loading a non-message mapper class yields no result.

methods.name: createWithFactoryMethod
methods.description: Tests creation of a message mapper instance using a factory method.

methods.name: createWithClassName
methods.description: Tests creation of a message mapper instance based on class name.

methods.name: createWithClassNameFindsNoClass
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the class name does not correspond to any class.

methods.name: createWithClassNameFailsForNonMapperClass
methods.description: Verifies behavior when attempting to create a mapper from a class that isn't a mapper.

methods.name: loadMapperWithInvalidConfig
methods.description: Tests loading a mapper with invalid configuration.

methods.name: loadMapperWithoutContentType
methods.description: Tests loading a mapper when content type information is missing.

methods.name: loadFallbackMappersByAlias
methods.description: Verifies the loading of fallback mappers via alias, ensuring correct registry composition.

methods.name: loadRegistry
methods.description: Tests the loading and retrieval of a mapper registry with specific mappings.
